items.heading: 九年级上册 Module 10 Australia
items.topic: 澳大利亚（定语从句）；词汇对齐：central / according to / magical / height / sailing boat / northeast / sheep / hat / keep / keep sb./sth. away / fly / scissors / cut sth. off sth. / wool / diary / keep a diary / hate / ant / brush / at the time / be surprised at / period / period

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: Where did you go last summer, Tom?

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: I went to Australia. It is a magical place with a lot of beautiful sights.

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: What did you see there?

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: I saw many sheep on the hills, and I even took a sailing boat on the sea. I kept a diary every night about my trip.

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: That sounds amazing. What was the best part?

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: I think it was the mountains in the northeast, where the old rocks reach a great height.

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: Wow, I hope I can go there one day.

reading.title: My Trip to Australia
paragraphs: Last summer, my family travelled to Australia, a country in the southern part of the world. It is a huge land with both modern cities and wild nature.

Australia is famous for its open land. In the central part of the country, the ground is red and dry. Further north and east, there are green hills and mountains that reach a great height. We drove for hours and hours, and we saw farm after farm. The fields were full of sheep, and sometimes we saw a single sheep in the middle of the road, looking at us with a funny face.
One of my favourite days was when we took a sailing boat. The wind was strong, and the sea was blue. I stood at the front of the boat and felt the cool air on my face. It was a magical moment.

At night, I would sit with a diary and write about everything I had seen. I wanted to remember the smell of the land, the sound of the birds, and the feeling of being far from home. I had to be careful, though, because the flies and ants were everywhere. I kept them away with a net and a wide hat, and I was surprised at how quickly they came back.
In the city, I saw the famous bridge and the tall tower. I learned about the old culture of the people who lived there for thousands of years before us.
I came home with a lot of new ideas. Australia is more than a place on the map. It is a beautiful and different world. If you ever have the chance, go and see it for yourself.

words.sentence: In the central part of the country...
I kept them away with a net...
I was surprised at how quickly...

items.heading: 九年级上册 Module 11 Photos
items.topic: 摄影与照片；词汇对齐：bet / you bet / the thing is / general / standard / feeling / difficulty / subject / add / recently / menu / be in with a chance / tonight / read out / winner / compared with / even though / rush / blouse / skirt / protect sth. against sth. / singer / congratulations / headmaster

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: There is a photo competition this evening. Are you entering?

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: You bet! I took a picture of a beautiful sky last week. The feeling was really strong.

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: I think you are in with a chance to win.

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: Thanks, but I am still nervous. I have been working on the subject for days, but recently the light has not been good.

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: Do not worry. Even though there are many photos, I believe yours is special.

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: I hope so. I will show it to the headmaster tonight.

reading.title: The Moment in the Photograph
paragraphs: When I was a child, my mother gave me a small camera. She said, "A photograph can hold a moment forever." I did not understand her then, but today I do.

Photography is more than a way to take a picture. It is a way to capture a feeling. A good photograph is not just a copy of the world. It shows us the light in the sky, the smile on a face, or the quiet of a street at night. It can make us feel happy, sad, or surprised.
Last month, our school announced a photo competition. The subject was "Life in My Town." I wanted to take a picture that showed the heart of my home.

For days, I walked around with my camera. I saw many beautiful things, but I was not happy with them. Compared with the pictures on the Internet, they seemed nothing special. Then, one evening, I was walking home when the sky turned red and gold. An old man was sitting on the bank with his dog, and the light fell softly on them. I raised my camera and took one picture.
The photo was not perfect. The light was low, and the man was not in the middle of the picture. But it showed something real - a quiet moment of love between a man and his dog.
The next day, the winners were read out. I could not believe my ears when I heard my name. I won the first prize!

At the ceremony, the headmaster said that the best photographs are not the most beautiful, but the most honest. They protect a true feeling against the passing of time. I understood then what my mother meant. A photograph is not only an image. It is a memory that we can hold in our hands.

words.sentence: The subject was "Life in My Town."
Recently the light has not been good.
You are in with a chance to win.
Even though there are many photos...
They protect a true feeling against time.

items.heading: 九年级上册 Module 12 Save our world
items.topic: 环保（reduce, reuse, recycle）；词汇对齐：factory / pollute / recycle / waste / enemy / crop / kill / oil / less / hopeless / china / divide / plastic / policy / reuse / bottle / throw away / repeat / cloth / ton / tons of / rubber / recycling / rapid

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: Have you seen the new film about the environment?

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: Yes. It shows how a factory pollutes the river, and how a lot of plastic is thrown away every day.

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: It makes me think. We can reduce, reuse and recycle. For example, we can use a bottle again instead of throwing it away.

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: That is a good start. If everyone does a little, the world will be saved.

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: You are right. It is not hopeless. We just need to act, and to act now.

reading.title: Save Our World
paragraphs: Our planet is a wonderful place, but we are giving it a hard time. Every day, factories send smoke into the air, cars fill the streets, and mountains of waste grow by the side of the road. This is a serious problem, and it is growing fast.
Some people think that nothing can be done. But the truth is that we can help. The best way is to remember three simple words: reduce, reuse and recycle.
To reduce means to use less. We can save energy by turning off the lights when we leave a room. We can use less water when we brush our teeth. We can buy fewer things that we do not really need.

To reuse means to use a thing again. A glass bottle can hold water for many days before it is empty. An old cloth can become a bag or a rag. We can use both sides of a piece of paper, and pass an old book to a younger friend. In this way, we do not throw away things that are still useful.
To recycle means to make new things from old ones. Paper, plastic, glass and rubber can all be made into new products. By recycling, we make less rubbish and we save the earth's resources.
We can also act together in a bigger way. We can ask the government to make good policy, and we can join a recycling group in our town. Even a small change in our daily life can help.
The earth is our only home. It is not too late, but the time is running out. If everyone does a little, together we can save our world.

words.sentence: To reduce means to use less.
To reuse means to use a thing again.
An old cloth can become a bag...

items.heading: 九年级上册 Module 1 Wonders of the world
items.topic: 世界奇观（时态复习）；词汇对齐：man-made / natural / wonder / discussion / eastern / though / loud / wow / opinion / in one's opinion / more than / electricity / millions of / below / shine / sign / silent / silver / sky / grey / go through / beside / reply / clear

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: Have you seen the Great Wall, Leo?

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: Yes, I have. It is an amazing man-made wonder. I think it is even more than a wall; it is a part of history.

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: I agree. In my opinion, the best wonders are the natural ones, like the mountains and the sea.

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: Both are wonderful in different ways. What would you say is the greatest wonder of all?

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: Maybe the sky at night, when it is clear and full of stars.

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: Wow, that is a beautiful answer. Let us go and see it together.

reading.title: Wonders of the World
paragraphs: Since the beginning of time, people have been amazed by the world around them. We have looked up at the high mountains, walked beside the deep rivers, and wondered at the beauty of the earth. These great sights are called the wonders of the world.

Some wonders are natural. The Grand Canyon, with its deep walls and shining rocks, is one of them. The mountains of the east, the silver sea and the great forests are all natural wonders. They are silent and huge, full of the power of nature. When we stand below a high cliff, we feel very small.

Other wonders are man-made. The Great Wall of China, the pyramids of Egypt and the ancient bridges and palaces are works of human hands. They took years to build, and millions of people have worked on them. They show what people can do when they work together.

People have different opinions about the greatest wonder. In my opinion, the most wonderful thing is not a single place. It is the way that the sky changes: the clouds that turn grey before rain, the bright light that shines after a storm, and the clear stars that appear at night. This is a wonder we can see every day.
We do not have to travel far to find a wonder. If we take our time and look around, we will find beauty everywhere. The world is full of surprises, and it is waiting for us to discover them.

words.sentence: ...wondered at the beauty of the earth.
It is even more than a wall...

items.heading: 九年级上册 Module 2 Public holidays
items.topic: 公共节日；词汇对齐：found / since then / flag / until / off / all kinds of / vacation / take a vacation / season / kid / have fun / band / UK / as soon as / fourth / sixth / seventh / eighth / ninth / tenth / twelfth / twentieth / among / speech

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: What is your favourite public holiday, Jack?

dialogue.speaker: Jack
dialogue.text: The National Day holiday. We have a week off, and everybody has fun.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: What do you usually do?

dialogue.speaker: Jack
dialogue.text: I visit my grandparents in the countryside. As soon as I get there, my cousin and I go out to play.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: On public holidays, many people take a vacation or watch the flag rise.

dialogue.speaker: Jack
dialogue.text: Yes. Each season has its own holiday, and there is always a reason to celebrate.

reading.title: Days for Everyone
paragraphs: Every country has its own public holidays. Some are about a great event in history, and others are about the seasons or the harvest. They are days when people do not go to work or school, and the whole country stops to rest and to have fun.

In the UK, there are holidays that go back a long time. People stay at home, cook special food, and watch the flag rise over the square. Children have a vacation, and families travel from one place to another. There are all kinds of interesting things to do.

In my country, the most important public holiday is the National Day. Since then, every year on this day, we remember the start of our country. The streets are full of flags, and the speeches on television tell the story of our people. At night, the sky is bright with fireworks. We take a vacation to be with our families and friends.

Many holidays celebrate the changing seasons. In spring, people welcome the new year and the new plants. In summer, they enjoy the long days and go to the sea. In autumn, they thank the earth for the harvest. In winter, they rest by the fire and wait for the quiet snow.
Most of the holidays in a year come from old traditions, but they are still alive today. On these special days, old and young sit together, and the same old stories are told again.
A holiday is a gift. It gives us time, and time is the best present of all. So when the next holiday comes, put down your books and enjoy the moment with the people you love.

words.sentence: As soon as I get there...

items.heading: 九年级上册 Module 3 Heroes
items.topic: 英雄人物；词汇对齐：including / medal / attend / abroad / once again / doctor / degree / whatever / give up / amazing / will / victory / simply / Canadian / sick / soldier / treat / war / wound / die for / wounded / realise / dying / care

dialogue.speaker: Lucy
dialogue.text: Who is your hero, Ben?

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.text: My grandfather. He was a soldier, but he became a doctor after the war.

dialogue.speaker: Lucy
dialogue.text: Did he study abroad?

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.text: Yes. He went to Canada and got a degree. But when he came back, he found the people in his village were sick and had no doctors.

dialogue.speaker: Lucy
dialogue.text: So he stayed and helped them?

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.text: He did. He treated the sick for the rest of his life. My grandfather was an amazing man, and he never gave up.

reading.title: A True Hero
paragraphs: We often think of heroes as strong and famous people on the news. But a real hero may be a neighbour, a teacher, or even a member of our own family.

My grandfather was such a hero. He was born in a small village. When he was young, a war broke out, and he became a soldier. He fought bravely, and he saw many of his friends die for our country. When the war ended, he decided to become a doctor to help people who were sick and wounded.

There was no medical school near his home, so he travelled far away to study for a degree. He worked hard, and he once again went to the battlefield, this time as a doctor. He treated the wounded with care, and he never gave up, even when the work was hard.

After the war, he could have lived a quiet life in the city. Instead, he chose to return to the countryside. He knew that the villagers had no doctor, and he wanted to help them. He opened a small clinic and treated the sick for many years. The people loved him, and they called him "our doctor."

My grandfather did not win a medal, and he was not famous. But he was a hero in the truest sense. He realised that the greatest victory was not winning a fight, but saving a life. Whatever he did, he did with love.
I want to be like him. I want to help people, and I want to have the same simple courage. That, to me, is what makes a hero.

items.heading: 九年级上册 Module 4 Home alone
items.topic: 独自在家（让步状语从句）；词汇对齐：platform / meeting / miss / shut / lock / simple / anybody / clock / ring / passenger / address / text / text message / couple / a couple of / actually / manage / unhappy / turn off / order / be worried about / business / on business / sofa

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: Where are your parents, Lucy?

dialogue.speaker: Lucy
dialogue.text: They are away on business. I am home alone for a couple of days.

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: Do you like it?

dialogue.speaker: Lucy
dialogue.text: At first it was fun. But this morning I missed the bus, and I was late for school.

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: I see. It is not as simple as it looks.

dialogue.speaker: Lucy
dialogue.text: You are right. Although I can manage most things, I still feel a little lonely at night.

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: Make sure you lock the door and turn off the lights before you sleep.

reading.title: A Few Days Alone
paragraphs: This week, my parents went on business, and I stayed home alone. At first, I was very happy. I thought it would be a simple and easy life. I could stay up late, eat what I wanted, and watch television all day.

But I soon learned that living alone is not so easy. On the first morning, the alarm clock did not ring, and I woke up late. I ran to the station, but I had already missed the train. I was late for school, and my teacher was not happy with me.

At home, there was more to think about. I had to lock the door, cook my own food, and do the housework. A couple of times, I did something wrong. Once, I put the laundry in the washing machine and the phone rang while I was not looking. The water was everywhere.
My parents called me every evening. "Are you all right?" they asked. "Are you eating well? Did you turn off the gas?" They were worried about me.
Although I had a lot of freedom, I slowly found that I missed them. I missed my mother's cooking and my father's stories. The house was quiet, and I felt unhappy. The sofa felt empty without them.
At the end of the week, my parents came home. I was so glad to see them that I ran to the door.
I learned an important lesson. Being home alone is a way to grow up, but it is also a way to understand how much our families do for us. Freedom is good, but love is even better.

words.sentence: I had to lock the door...
The alarm clock did not ring...

items.heading: 九年级上册 Module 5 Museums
items.topic: 博物馆与规则；词汇对齐：upstairs / exhibition / rule / against the rules / in trouble / tail / rope / entry / no entry / no good / no wonder / missing / downstairs / punish / communications / physics / chemistry / dig / coal / energy / X-ray / experiment / sand / control

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.text: Have you been to the science museum?

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: Yes, it is my favourite place. There is an exhibition about energy upstairs.

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.text: What can you do there?

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: You can try a lot of experiments. Once I dug into the sand to find real fossils.

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.text: Are there many rules?

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: Yes. You must not touch the rope, and some rooms are no entry. If you break the rules, you will be in trouble.

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.text: I see. No wonder they are so careful, because the things are very valuable.

reading.title: A Day at the Museum
paragraphs: My favourite place in the city is the science museum. It is a big, bright building with exhibitions about space, energy, physics and chemistry. It is a place where you can learn by doing, not just by reading.

When you go upstairs, you enter the world of energy. You can see how electricity is made, how a machine works, and how the sun gives us power. You can even stand on a machine and make the lights come on with your own movement.

Downstairs, there is a special room for experiments. Here, you can mix things, test the weight of an object, and look at an X-ray. My favourite activity is digging into the sand to find old bones and ancient things. I once found a small rock and a real fossil. It felt like I was a scientist!

But a museum has rules, and they are important. You must not cross the rope that keeps people away from the valuable things. Some rooms say "no entry" because they are for the workers. If you get into trouble or break a rule, you may be punished or asked to leave. No wonder the teachers tell us to read the signs first.
People in a museum show respect. They speak quietly, keep their hands to themselves, and wait their turn. In this way, everybody can enjoy the wonder of science together.
After my visit, I always go home with a full head of new ideas. A museum is not a boring place. It is a door to the wonderful world of knowledge, and it is open to everyone.

words.sentence: No wonder they are so careful...
Downstairs, there is a special room...

items.heading: 九年级上册 Module 6 Problems
items.topic: 问题与建议（if 条件句）；词汇对齐：deal / exam / fail / guitar / instrument / musical / habit / get into the habit of / schoolwork / volunteer / necessary / shame / instead / instead of / community / knowledge / point / consider / last word / come round / reason / try out / angry / no longer

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: You look worried. Is something wrong, Lily?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.text: I have a problem. I want to play the guitar, but my parents say I should focus on my schoolwork.

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: Can you find a way to do both?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.text: I think I can. If I practise for thirty minutes after homework, I will not fail my exams.

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: That is a good plan. If you show them you are serious, they may reconsider.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.text: You are right. Helping in the community is also a good way to learn new skills.

reading.title: Solving a Problem
paragraphs: We all have problems. Some are big, and some are small. A problem can be about school, about work, or about our family. The important thing is not to run away from it, but to deal with it in a good way.

Last term, my friend Lily had a problem. She loved music and had got into the habit of playing the guitar every evening. But her parents were worried about her exams. They told her that if she failed the test, she would have to give up music. Lily was very unhappy, and she did not know what to do.
One day, she came round to my house and told me everything. "I do not want to lose my music," she said. "But I am afraid of failing my exams."

We talked for a long time. I said, "Maybe you should try out a new plan. Instead of playing for two hours, play for half an hour after you finish your homework. In this way, you can still enjoy your hobby, and your parents will see that you are serious."

Lily took my advice. She made a list of her schoolwork and worked on it first. Then she practised the guitar for a short time. A month later, her marks in the exam were very good. Her parents were pleased, and they let her play music again.
Lily learned something important. A problem is not a shame. It is a chance to think and to grow. If we consider the reasons and speak to the people we trust, we can always find a way out.
If you have a problem today, do not worry too much. Take a deep breath, make a plan, and ask for help. In the end, you may become stronger than before.

words.sentence: ...deal with it in a good way.
A problem is not a shame.
Instead, think of a plan.（拓展）
Instead of playing for two hours...
She came round to my house...
Maybe you should try out a new plan.

items.heading: 九年级上册 Module 7 Great books
items.topic: 名著（被动语态）；词汇对齐：discuss / thinker / wise / review / influence / sense / make sense / by the way / suppose / well-known / adventure / get into trouble / run away / escape / cave / dead / for a time / neighbour / funeral / surprised / alive / southern / state / pay for

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: What are you reading, Tom?

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: A well-known novel. It is an adventure story about a boy who runs away and lives on a river.

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: I have heard of it. Do you like the main character?

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: Yes, he is a wise and brave boy. He gets into trouble, but he always finds a way out.

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: Great books are still loved by people today, aren't they?

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: They are. They make us think, and that is why they are never forgotten.

reading.title: Why Great Books Live On
paragraphs: Some books are read once and then forgotten. Others are loved for a hundred years. These are the great books, and the reason they live on is that they speak to people in every age.

A great book tells a story, but it does more than that. It makes us think about life. When we read an adventure novel, we travel with the hero. When he gets into trouble, we feel his fear. When he escapes from danger, we feel glad. In this way, a good writer makes us understand the world through another person's eyes.

Many great books were written a long time ago, but their ideas are still important in our lives. A wise thinker once wrote about friendship, about honesty and about the choices we make. We still discuss these questions today. When we read such a book, we say that its words make sense to us.

Books can also shape our history. A famous book about freedom, or about the lives of ordinary people, can influence a whole state or a nation. It can be a voice for those who cannot speak. It can be a mirror in which we see ourselves.
Some great books are hard, and some are full of fun and adventure. But all of them have something to give us. They are the treasure of our culture, passed from hand to hand, from parents to children.

So do not be in a hurry. Take a little time, and pick up a great book. A story about a boy on a river, or a man who lives in a cave, may change the way you see the world. A great book is a friend for life.

words.sentence: He is a wise and brave boy.

items.heading: 九年级上册 Module 8 Sports life
items.topic: 体育生活（被动语态）；词汇对齐：stand for / memory / point / decision / excuse / noon / seat / no way / fair / kick / mad / sportsman / high jump / ability / hurdling / sportswoman / race / record / method / hurdles / break / sportsperson / Asian

dialogue.speaker: Jack
dialogue.text: The school sports meeting is next week. Are you going to take part?

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: Yes. I will run in the race and try to break the school record.

dialogue.speaker: Jack
dialogue.text: Good luck. I prefer the high jump, but I am not very good at it.

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: Do not worry. You just need to practise more. A good method is important.

dialogue.speaker: Jack
dialogue.text: You are right. The competition is not only about winning; it is also about fair play.

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: That is what sport really stands for - teamwork, effort and respect.

reading.title: The Spirit of Sport
paragraphs: Every year, our school holds a sports meeting. The students run, jump, race and cheer. It is a day full of excitement and energy, and everyone wants to win.

Last year, I watched the final race. The athletes ran as fast as the wind, and the crowd was on its feet. At the last moment, one runner fell. The audience feared that the race was over. But the poor girl got back up and kept running. Even though she came last, everybody clapped for her, and her friends ran to help her.

That moment taught me what sport really means. Sport is not only about winning a race or breaking a record. It is about the ability to try, the fair play we show, and the respect we give to each other.

The athletes train hard for months. They learn a method, they practise every day, and they push themselves to do better. A good sportsman or sportswoman also knows how to lose. When they fail, they do not make excuses. They simply work harder next time.
Sport gives us many things. It makes our bodies strong and our minds clear. It teaches us to work with others and to trust our team. It gives us a memory to keep for a lifetime.
The spirit of sport lives in all of us. It is a light that is fair, brave and kind. When we play, we do not have to be the best. We just have to give our best.

items.heading: 九年级上册 Module 9 Great inventions
items.topic: 伟大发明（被动语态）；词汇对齐：borrow / put up / website / mail / textbook / mainly / thousands of / page / electronic / technology / powerful / memory / full / fix / instructions / lend / properly / look through / printing / at a time / by hand / development / trade / result

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: What is the greatest invention in your opinion, Leo?

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: I think it is printing. Before it, books were made by hand, and few people could read.

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: That is true. Look at us now - I can read a book or look at a website on my phone.

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: Yes, electronic books are powerful, but it is still nice to hold a real book in your hand.

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: I agree. Technology changes our lives, but some traditions are worth keeping.

reading.title: The Power of Invention
paragraphs: Look around you. The lights in the room, the pen on the desk, and the computer in front of you - all of these are inventions. An invention is an idea that becomes a thing, and it can change the way we live.

Some inventions changed the world more than others. Printing is one of them. Before printing, a book was copied by hand, page by page. It took a long time, and only a few people could read. Then printing was invented. Thousands of books were made quickly, and knowledge travelled from one place to another. Schools grew, and more people learned to read.

In our time, new technology changes our lives almost every day. We borrow books from the library, but we can also read them on a small electronic screen. We send mail through the Internet. We can look through a website, find the answer to a question, and speak to a friend on another side of the world.

Inventions also come from our questions. A person asks, "Can I do this in a better way?" Then they work on an idea, make a plan, and test it. If the result is good, the idea becomes a tool. If it is not, they try again.
Of course, there are also problems. Sometimes we use too much energy, or we forget to be careful with our things. A good invention should be used properly.

The world of inventions is full of surprises. One day, you may have an idea that helps many people. Look around, ask questions, and do not be afraid to try. The next great invention is waiting to be born.

words.sentence: We borrow books from the library...
